predictions.rationale: Core domain model for Order; central to all order-related processes including creation, status tracking, and cancellation.
API controller handling HTTP requests for order creation, status updates, and cancellation.
Handles the business logic for creating orders at checkout.
Handles the business logic for cancelling orders.
Handles status transition to stock confirmed, a key step in order processing.
Handles status transition to paid, essential for order lifecycle.
Handles the shipment process, a final step in order fulfillment.
Defines and manages the various statuses an order can have throughout its lifecycle.
Represents the event when an order is started, triggering downstream processes.
Provides querying capabilities for retrieving order status and details.
